description: Fetch the photos on one place's listing, as URLs on Google's CDN; we do not rehost images. Dimensions and uploader are in the object, and null where the source does not give them. Give exactly one of `place_id` or `url`. Costs 4 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

limit.description: At most this many results, 1–20. A page can hold fewer while `next_cursor` is set: read until it is null.

url.description: The full URL of the place on Google Maps, which carries its id. A short maps.app.goo.gl link does not, so open it and copy the address it leads to.

name: get_place_photos
title: Get the photos of a Google Maps place
